what.text: This page follows refugees from Libya in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 17161 refugees from Libya.
The United Kingdom hosts the largest share, 36.1%, followed by Germany, France and Malta.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Libya in 2011, 2013 to 2015, 2017 and 2019 to 2020, with the Forces of the House of Representatives among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Libya from 2015 to 2019.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1980 at 205 refugees.
The figure reached its highest point, 19090, at the end of 2021, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2017 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country; people displaced inside Libya are counted separately.
